Detailed Description

Lock-free memory-mapped text logging with crash safety.

This module provides crash-safe logging by writing human-readable text directly to a memory-mapped log file. Key features:

  • Lock-free logging: Uses atomic fetch_add for position claiming
  • Crash-safe: Text is written directly to mmap'd file, readable after crash
  • No flusher needed: Logs are human-readable in the file immediately
  • Pure text: No binary header, works with grep/rg/cat without special flags
  • Simple design: Just mmap the .log file and write text to it

Usage:

// Initialize mmap logging (call once at startup)
log_mmap_init("/tmp/myapp.log", 4 * 1024 * 1024);  // 4MB log file
// Use normal log_* macros - they automatically use mmap backend
log_debug("This uses atomic operations, no mutex!");
// Cleanup on shutdown
log_mmap_destroy();

void
  log_mmap_rotate (void )


Rotate the mmap log (tail-keeping rotation). Keeps the most recent
    log entries (tail) and discards old ones. This is the mmap equivalent of
    file-based log rotation.




Note


Caller must hold the rotation mutex from logging.c. This
  is called by maybe_rotate_log() which handles locking.

428     return;
429   }
430
431   /* NOTE: Caller must hold the rotation mutex from logging.c */
432
433   uint64_t current_pos = atomic_load_u64(&g_mmap_log.write_pos);
434   size_t capacity = g_mmap_log.text_capacity;
435
436   /* Keep last 2/3 of the log (same ratio as file rotation) */
437   size_t keep_size = capacity * 2 / 3;
438   if (current_pos <= keep_size) {
439     return;
440   }
441
442   /* Find where to start keeping (skip to beginning of current_pos - keep_size) */
443   size_t skip_bytes = (size_t)current_pos - keep_size;
444   char *keep_start = g_mmap_log.text_region + skip_bytes;
445
446   /* Skip to next line boundary to avoid partial lines */
447   size_t skipped = 0;
448   while (skipped < keep_size && *keep_start != '\n') {
449     keep_start++;
450     skipped++;
451   }
452   if (skipped < keep_size && *keep_start == '\n') {
453     keep_start++;
454     skipped++;
455   }
456
457   size_t actual_keep = keep_size - skipped;
458   if (actual_keep == 0) {
459     /* Nothing to keep - just reset */
460     atomic_store_u64(&g_mmap_log.write_pos, 0);
461     memset(g_mmap_log.text_region, '\n', capacity);
462     return;
463   }
464
465   /* Move the tail to the beginning using memmove (handles overlap) */
466   memmove(g_mmap_log.text_region, keep_start, actual_keep);
467
468   /* Clear the rest with newlines (grep-friendly without needing -a flag) */
469   memset(g_mmap_log.text_region + actual_keep, '\n', capacity - actual_keep);
470
471   /* Update write position */
472   atomic_store_u64(&g_mmap_log.write_pos, actual_keep);
473
474   /* Write rotation marker */
475   const char *rotate_msg = "\n=== LOG ROTATED ===\n";
476   size_t rotate_len = strlen(rotate_msg);
477   if (actual_keep + rotate_len < capacity) {
478     memcpy(g_mmap_log.text_region + actual_keep, rotate_msg, rotate_len);
479     atomic_store_u64(&g_mmap_log.write_pos, actual_keep + rotate_len);
480   }
481
482   atomic_fetch_add_u64(&g_mmap_log.wrap_count, 1);
483
484   /* Sync after rotation */
485   platform_mmap_sync(&g_mmap_log.mmap, true);
